concepts.reader_question: Forecast đổi, lô nào cần xem trước?
concepts.description: Create one finished square native PNG1254 intent/min1080. Exact artwork_text/header/logo only, preserve every punctuation mark: add none, omit none. Caption/nativeheadline/alt/internal metadata outside raster. Stable R2/Sol photographic office/daylight white-blue material family, useful integrated diagrams, semiconductor signals appropriate Fabless rather than mandatory OSATtray. Background records completely blank, no microglyphs/chart/identifiers/dates/labels beyondapproved text; no ticks/seals/badges/completed-state. Strong readableheadline/body with generous spacing. Two offset translucent planning planes meet an open selection area containing unmarked semiconductor lot forms and a die-design tile. The offset implies changed planning input, with no graph, curve or forecast values.

F2-A1.headline: Forecast đổi, lô nào cần xem trước?
F2-A1.body: Nếu dự báo nhu cầu thay đổi, nhóm kế hoạch cần xác định các lô gia công liên quan trước khi trao đổi điều chỉnh với đối tác.
